project.title: typhoon_ocr_flutter
project.tagline: A Flutter package for structured document OCR with Typhoon OCR providers.

summary.short: typhoon_ocr_flutter provides a Flutter-friendly client and structured document models for Typhoon OCR, including Thai ID cards, receipts, bank slips, passports, and general documents.
summary.long: The package includes provider configuration, document-specific parsing and validation, examples for Thai ID scanning, documentation for API-key setup, and a public package release workflow.

highlights: Receipt, bank slip, passport, and general document support
